text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — getting a cluster of feature asks from a few accounts. thinking we should funnel into a short sprint intake and triage tomorrow. quick list below.
Ben (CS): +1. raw notes from calls: NovaRetail wants per-route cost breakdowns (billing transparency). HelixHealth flagged SSO + audit logs gap during onboarding. OrbitApps asked for bulk-embedding tooling (large file uploads timeout). Two smaller asks: RBAC by team and private-model mapping in console.
Liam (PM): Good call. can you rank by renewal risk / revenue impact? we should push anything blocking renewals to the top.
Maya (CS): Quick pass: NovaRetail = high impact (renewal in 6 weeks, heavy usage), HelixHealth = medium-high (compliance checklist for go-live), OrbitApps = medium (engineering workaround exists but expensive). RBAC = low-medium (multiple small accounts). Private-model mapping = low for revenue but could reduce support tickets.
Tony (Eng): For per-route cost breakdown: front-end + billing pipeline change. estimate ~2w to prototype + 1w to stabilize. bulk-embedding: depends on streaming + chunking, maybe 3w. RBAC probably 1-2w.
Sarah (Onboarding): I can draft an SSO + audit-log runbook for HelixHealth today and pair with support for the initial cut. that might reduce their go/no-go risk.
Liam (PM): Proposal: 1) NovaRetail cost breakdown => can we get a lightweight prototype (read-only per-route view) next sprint? 2) HelixHealth SSO runbook + temporary audit exports this week. 3) OrbitApps — schedule engineering spike for chunked embeddings. prioritize in that order.
Ben (CS): I'll confirm NovaRetail's exact renewal date + scale metrics and add usage samples to the ticket. also collecting any specific billing views they want (per-model vs per-route).
Tony (Eng): Quick Q: for the prototype per-route view, do we need exact historical cost attribution or an estimated projection? exact historical could require reprocessing.
Maya (CS): For NovaRetail they asked for historical by route for last 90 days. estimate is fine for now but they prefer near-accurate numbers.
Liam (PM): Tony, do the prototype as an estimated projection (lower infra cost) and mark as "accuracy phase" after NovaRetail signoff.
FeedbackBot: New feedback survey aggregated: https://feedback.redwood.ai/summaries/1854 — includes 12 mentions of "billing clarity" and 8 of "onboarding docs".
Sarah (Onboarding): I'll post the draft runbook in #onboarding and tag HelixHealth.
Maya (CS): OK — action items: Ben add NovaRetail usage to GH ticket, Sarah post runbook + tag, Tony spike for per-route prototype (est 2w), Liam to add to product roadmap and assign priorities. Triage meeting set: tomorrow 10am.
Liam (PM): Thanks — I'll create the roadmap cards and add estimated effort.
Ben (CS): Adding notes to the account health board now. ping me if anyone wants the call notes. :thumbsup:
Tony (Eng): I'll pick up the prototype ticket after the spike backlog is finalized.
Maya (CS): Nice work team. let's keep this lean and focus on renewal blockers.
